name: mirage
text: Yes, it did. The other device (SM-S156V) published its own default settings over yours, and that included most of the bid and bet rules. I've put them back to the values from before it connected (cloud-config commit 63d240658). The engine reads them at once, and your main phone will pick them up next time it syncs. What I restored: auto-bet kinds are prop, moneyline and team total only, and bid kinds are prop and team total only. Bids are back to eighth Kelly, with the 1.8% margin, the stricter sharp-book requirement, the 72 h trap guard and no cap on the number of bids. The bet slider is back at 50, profit-proven only is back on, and the live-bid settings are restored. The league list is back to NBA, NFL, NHL, ATP, WTA, NCAAB and NCAAF. OddsPapi Free and Pinnacle are off again. I left its harmless changes alone (sockets on, scan study on). One caution: if that device is still open and uses its own settings, it can overwrite them again. Please close or sign out of it, or tell me and I'll check again.
